articles.summary: CAVA Group, Inc. (NYSE: CAVA), the category-defining Mediterranean fast-casual restaurant brand that brings heart, health, and humanity to food, will host a conference call on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 5:00 PM Eastern Time to discuss third quarter 2026 financial results and provide a business update. A press release with third quarter financial results will be issued at approximately 4:10 PM Eastern Time on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. The call will be webcast live from the Company’s website on the investor relations page at investor.cava.com . A recorded webcast will be available on CAVA’s investor relations website shortly after the call and available for up to one year. About CAVA CAVA is the category-defining Mediterranean fast-casual restaurant brand bringing together bold, healthful flavors and ingredients at scale. articles.title: CAVA to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 4th, 2026

articles.summary: Bold Mediterranean flavor and feel-good ingredients take center stage this fall, alongside a larger-than-life celebration coming to New York City. CAVA is channeling Greek Goddess energy with a fresh lineup of offerings built around an all-new Greek Goddess dressing. The latest innovations pair fresh, herby Mediterranean flavors with wholesome ingredients, alongside a seasonal Pomegranate Apple drink. CAVA's new Greek Goddess Salmon Bowl To celebrate the launch — and prove it’s no myth that big flavor and healthful choices go hand in hand — CAVA is taking inspiration from the ancient Greeks themselves, with a one-of-a-kind Greek Goddess arriving in New York City tomorrow. The center of the celebration? CAVA’s new Greek Goddess dressing, a tangy blend of rich Greek yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, herbs, and spices.
